item.title: Five Kettlebell Moves on Three Axes
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. Five movements land on three axes. The hips produce the power, the shoulders buy the range, the diagonal carries force across the trunk. The snatch sits where all three meet, which is why it is the one you cannot swap out. The film runs 26 seconds with no voice-over. The labels on screen are the language of this page.
